Code One Select_Multiple Question as 0/1/NA

Source: R/route_analysis.R
ck_route_sm.Rd

Code One Select_Multiple Question as 0/1/NA

Usage

ck_route_sm(data, parent, sm_separator)

Arguments

data

The dataset, label row removed.

parent

The parent question.

sm_separator

The select_multiple separator.

Value

A numeric matrix, one column per choice (named by the choice), NA in rows that were not asked; NULL when the question has no children.
